g.text: Negative differences remain in both ECDFs and in the d < 300 s counts. Dashed line: 300 s.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #374151

g.text: The ECDF uses ≤ d; the table uses strict < 300 s and excludes values equal to 300. The right panel is a display zoom only.
